gpuMs.note: gpuMs.* brackets the draw into the swap-chain buffer and can include waiting for DWM to release it; bench.* is the pure GPU cost

live-glass-renders.note: 631 presents through D3D11 + DirectComposition with WDA exclusion

gpu-budget.note: pure GPU cost 0.043 ms per frame (timestamp p95 0.043, throughput 0.042) for ROI copy+mips+glass draw of a 1500x196 bar (target <= 3 ms)

backdrop-age.note: p95 age of the backdrop frame when drawn: 125 ms (target <= 2 refresh periods); WGC only delivers frames when the screen changes, so high values can mean a static desktop

no-self-echo.note: static phase: 216 capture frames dirty only inside the glass vs 10 elsewhere; capture 45.2 fps vs 2 fps without glass

echo-filter.note: with filter: capture 8.1 fps, 24 echo frames skipped, 12 real changes under the glass drawn (12 colour flips), 13 outside changes
